baseline.sql:
SELECT c.city,COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id),SUM(ol.qty*p.price)
FROM customer c JOIN orders o USING(customer_id) JOIN order_line ol USING(order_id)
JOIN product p USING(product_id) WHERE o.ordered_on >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ordered_on < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY SUM(ol.qty*p.price) DESC
